    • runDynamicScenario

      public DynamicSafetyScenarioResult runDynamicScenario(DynamicSafetyScenario scenario, Collection<String> pidTags)
      Runs an explicitly configured dynamic test with strict capability preflight on its configured process copy.

      Factories and criterion extractors should resolve their P&ID tags through this session's binding register using the isolated process supplied by the existing scenario runner. Unbound objects outside the declared test scope remain visible in the register and are never counted as tested. The scenario must declare the actual simulation names for all exercised P&ID tags so its retained equipment-tag evidence maps back through the saved register. Event-exact execution retains the runner's end-of-step logic scan: for scan-executed actions, an initiating-event-to-safe-state deadline includes the declared control scan as well as actuator stroke time.

      Parameters:
      scenario - controlled initiating event, logic and measurable acceptance criteria
      pidTags - explicitly exercised P&ID tags
      Returns:
      dynamic response evidence, including failed preflight or initialization
